task.description: Narrow rework requested by REVIEWER step-02d-recheck1 (FAILED item 1 only; item 2, the FK-constraint fix, was already confirmed PASS and untouched): (1) gate the test-only activate_group pause seam behind a compile-time Application.compile_env(:letflow, :activation_test_hooks_enabled?, false) flag so it is a genuine no-op in dev/prod builds, not merely hard to trigger by accident; (2) fix the false moduledoc/typedoc claim that the public @spec 'intentionally omits' test_opts() when the @spec actually listed it directly.
acceptance_criteria: maybe_add_test_pause_step's functional path is gated by @activation_test_hooks_enabled?, a module attribute resolved once via Application.compile_env(:letflow, :activation_test_hooks_enabled?, false)

result.summary:
Both REVIEWER-required fixes landed in lib/letflow/repository/activation.ex, plus one config/test.exs addition; no other file touched. The FK-constraint fix from rework1 (foreign_key_constraint(:active_version_id, ...) in Activation.changeset/2, used by both branches of upsert_activation_pointer/8) was left untouched, per REVIEWER's explicit instruction.

FIX 1 (compile-time kill switch): Added `@activation_test_hooks_enabled? Application.compile_env(:letflow, :activation_test_hooks_enabled?, false)` as a module attribute (activation.ex, near the test_opts type), resolved once at compile time -- matches lib/letflow/design/req021-auth-plug-pipeline.md's OQ-5 precedent (config-resolved indirection, not ad hoc Mix.env() branching) exactly as REVIEWER directed. `config/test.exs` now sets `config :letflow, activation_test_hooks_enabled?: true`; grepped config/dev.exs and config/prod.exs -- neither sets this key, so compile_env's `false` default holds there.

Gating mechanism: rewrote `maybe_add_test_pause_step/3` (collapsed from two clauses taking separate index/pause_after/pause_fun args into one clause taking the full `opts` keyword list, extracting pause_after/pause_fun internally) to gate on `if @activation_test_hooks_enabled? and index == pause_after and is_function(pause_fun, 0) do ... else multi end`. Deliberately NOT expressed as a function-head guard (`when ... and @activation_test_hooks_enabled?`) -- tried that first, and Elixir's compiler statically proves `is_function(pause_fun, 0) and false` can never succeed under default (dev) MIX_ENV and rejects the module under `--warnings-as-errors` with 'this guard will never succeed'. The `if` form on the same compiled-in literal has no such restriction and still makes the pause step a genuine no-op whenever the flag is `false` -- verified by compiling clean under both MIX_ENV=dev (flag false) and MIX_ENV=test (flag true, opposite branch exercised) with `--warnings-as-errors`.

FIX 2 (false doc claim): Changed `@type test_opts` to `@typep test_opts` (private), and changed `activate_group/5`'s public `@spec` 5th-argument type from `test_opts()` to plain `keyword()`. Chose option (a) from REVIEWER's two suggested resolutions (remove test_opts() from the public @spec entirely, mark @typep) over option (b) (rewrite the claim) since it makes the existing claim literally true rather than just less wrong. Converted the `@typedoc` above `test_opts` into a plain comment, since `@typep`'s typedocs are always discarded by the compiler and keeping `@typedoc` there produced its own 'typedoc discarded for private type' warning under `--warnings-as-errors`. Added a `@spec maybe_add_test_pause_step(Multi.t(), pos_integer(), test_opts()) :: Multi.t()` on the private helper specifically so `test_opts()` has a real internal use site -- otherwise the compiler flags an unused-private-type warning, also fatal under `--warnings-as-errors`.

VERIFICATION (all run by me, this pass): `mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` under default MIX_ENV (dev): 170 files, 'Generated letflow app', clean, exit 0 -- confirms the flag's false default produces no dead-code warning and the seam compiles away cleanly. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` under MIX_ENV=test: 184 files, 'Generated letflow app', clean, exit 0 -- confirms the opposite (flag=true) branch also compiles clean. `mix format --check-formatted`: exit 0, no output (ran `mix format` once first to fix an indentation issue in the new `Application.compile_env(...)` call, then verified check-formatted passes with no diff). `mix test test/letflow/repository/activation_test.exs test/letflow/repository_test.exs test/letflow/repository/canonicaliser_test.exs` under MIX_ENV=test: 'Result: 67 passed', 0 failures -- same 67 tests as before, none touched, all pass with the flag enabled. Confirmed no other file in config/ sets `activation_test_hooks_enabled?` via `grep -n "activation_test_hooks_enabled" config/*.exs` -- only config/test.exs.

Did not touch: the FK-constraint fix (untouched, both branches of upsert_activation_pointer/8 still call the same Activation.changeset/2), test/letflow/repository/activation_test.exs (no assertions changed -- the seam's call shape at the only real call sites, which are all in that test file, is unaffected since `opts` is still accepted as a keyword list by activate_group/5's public API), and the design doc.
